It also sends the script ./migrate.sh (1210 bytes, 24 lines, SHA-256 4be1), all
    of it:

   1  #!/bin/sh
   2  set -eu
   3  cat > /etc/app/release.env <<'EOF'
   4  APP_PORT=8080
   5  APP_MODE=production
   6  EOF
   7  systemctl stop app
   8  cd /srv/app
   9  tar -xzf /tmp/release.tgz
  10  for f in migrations/*.sql; do
  11    psql -d app -f "$f"
  12  done
  13  chown -R deploy:deploy /srv/app
  14  systemctl start app
  15  for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  16    curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health && break
  17    sleep 2
  18  done
  19  journalctl -u app -n 20 --no-pager
  20  rm -f /tmp/release.tgz
  21  echo migrated
  22  date -u
  23  uptime
  24  exit 0
